scope: Actual UI export/save/reopen, closed-authoring-context independent playback at normal 1x speed: four bounded cycles per looping action with two adjacent fully observed cycles required, full one-shot jump recovery, and matched action requests. Functional evidence is separate from user visual acceptance.

captureMethod.observation: MutationObserver reads synchronized canvas metadata and captures the actually displayed canvas when the action/frame image changes.
captureMethod.flowReview: GIFs replay the latest observed canvas bitmap on a 24 FPS review timeline with 10 ms GIF duration rounding; they play once. No interpolation or replacement artwork is used.
captureMethod.boundaryMeaning: Boundary boards show the nearest observed canvas samples on either side of an action change, not guaranteed adjacent engine ticks or the exact configured route exit. Raw timestamps are retained; rendering and PNG capture can skip intermediate observations.
captureMethod.engineVerification: Exact route exits and time accounting are checked separately by motion-flow unit/E2E tests. Loop evidence requires two adjacent fully observed cycles within four bounded cycles; this does not assert all flow-recording ticks were observed.

flowRecapture.reason: One bounded replacement of four flow recordings after male PNG encoding stalls. Existing successful UI roundtrips, loop coverage, one-shot checks and original-default checks are retained from the initial run.
flowRecapture.method: During playback only drawImage copies into per-action/frame offscreen canvases; PNG encoding occurs after recording stops. All flow clips are independently loaded from the same byte-identical candidate packs already exported and verified by the UI.

recordingSelection.method: Keep complete per-mode recordings from the initial run and one deferred-encoding recapture. No further browser captures or individual pose selection.
recordingSelection.remainingLimit: Male/left queued recording retains a 247ms observation gap during celebration. Nearest captured boundary samples are not an exact engine-exit trace. Other selected active recordings have no observation gaps above90ms; terminal one-shot holds are intentional.
